candidate: The unchanged two-stage same-view exact-elite migration candidate: 5000 protected iterations followed by 20000 warm-started iterations per view, 20 fixed online complete checks in each stage, one protected 5-second route-pool MIP, one expanded 5-second route-pool MIP, and monotonic retention of the best independently feasible solution.

budget_correction.reason: A final HGS population can contain fewer than 24 distinct candidates. The algorithm evaluates every available distinct candidate up to the fixed cap; it must not waste calls by re-evaluating duplicates merely to hit an exact number.

failure_rule: Reject if any invariant fails, fewer than three tasks improve over protected stage 1, either strong electric view is beaten strictly on fewer than three tasks, or fewer than five main trajectories meet the genuine complete-incumbent shape gate. Do not alter depth, checkpoints, seeds, cases, budget cap, or thresholds after results.
claim_boundary: Development only. Passing authorizes a separately frozen confirmation and then a complete corrected E2 rerun; it is not itself paper evidence.
